features.name: overall_shannon_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy evaluated across entire binary (0.0 to 8.0)

features.name: file_size_bytes
features.description: Total size of the executable file in bytes

features.name: section_count
features.description: Total number of PE sections defined in section headers

features.name: max_section_entropy
features.description: Highest Shannon entropy observed among any individual PE section

features.name: compile_timestamp_anomaly
features.description: 1 if compilation timestamp is in the future or predates year 2000, 0 otherwise

features.name: is_signed
features.description: 1 if binary contains an embedded Authenticode digital signature, 0 if unsigned

features.name: clone_mismatch_detected
features.description: 1 if file claims commercial vendor identity (e.g. Google, VLC) without valid signature

features.name: wx_permission_risk
features.description: 1 if any section is simultaneously Writable (0x80000000) and Executable (0x20000000)

features.name: is_likely_packed
features.description: 1 if packing heuristics or known packer signatures (UPX, ASPack) are flagged

features.name: suspicious_imports_count
features.description: Count of imported Windows APIs flagged in threat dictionary

features.name: has_process_injection
features.description: 1 if Process Injection APIs (VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, CreateRemoteThread) present

features.name: has_masquerading
features.description: 1 if filename exhibits double extension (e.g. .pdf.exe) or document masquerading
